207.en:
Reusable Watercolour wrap in lilac and pink, with line-drawn flowers, for a snack in the park or at the office. The fabric imitates a watercolour wash that fades from pink to violet, with three large open-petalled flowers outlined in purple on top; the trim is violet and the flap fastens with two press studs.

It’s a pattern that doesn’t look childish, so it’s just as suitable for your own snack. Inside, the food-safe EVA layer protects cut fruit or biscuits, and when fully opened, you have a 20 × 26 cm napkin to place them on.

Wipe it clean with a damp cloth and put it back in your bag the next day. One wrap replaces the plastic bags used every afternoon.

It can feature a machine-embroidered name in our workshop in Barcelona; this option is available when ordering and works equally well for «Mum» or your daughter’s name.

282.en:
Waterproof Rainbow dummy holder, a nursery bag for the dummy and little treasures, featuring a girl riding a unicorn with a multicoloured mane. The illustration is pure light: a rainbow background, pink clouds and the white unicorn galloping with the brown-haired girl holding on to its mane.

It is the small piece in the set, measuring one palm across, and this model is offered on its own. It hangs from the adjustable cord on the pushchair handle or backpack, and inside there is room for the dummy, clip, teether or the stones your daughter collects in the park and refuses to let go of.

Inside, it has the same rubberised, liquid-repellent lining as the larger bags in the set: the dribbled dummy will not wet anything else. And if it gets dirty, just rinse it with water and it will be dry in no time.

The name is embroidered on a fabric cloud, in brown or pink. On such a small dummy holder, the cloud is the first thing you see.

373.en:
Plain backpack with an embroidered initial on a 9 × 9 cm patch, available in two sizes and ten colours, for school, nursery and everyday family life. In the photo, the navy one has a front zip pocket and a top handle; you choose the letter. One backpack per person, each with their own letter. The children’s one holds 9 litres and is for little ones up to six years old; the adult one holds 16 litres and is for older siblings, secondary school or the gym. Same design, different size, so nobody takes someone else’s.

One letter, six combinations

We embroider a single initial, from A to Z, in an outlined varsity font, with a choice of six thread combinations for the outline and centre. The initial is included with the backpack, and we do the embroidery in our workshop in Barcelona.

Ten colours, from red and fuchsia to graphite and camouflage, so everyone in the family can have their own. Optionally, add a gingham keyring with their name.
